correctness.rationale: The Coxeter-element path argument with the Bruhat subword property proves necessity of the component support criterion for all finite Coxeter systems. Absorption in parabolics proves sufficiency. Component assignments yield the exact local weight 2^(|C|+1)-1. Three rooted-tree states and directly checked branch-addition identities prove the recurrence for all subcubic trees; classification of finite irreducible Coxeter graphs completes the all-type theorem. Exhaustive direct Demazure multiplication on selected A/B/D systems and all labeled subcubic trees through six vertices independently corroborated finite cases.

value.rationale: Commuting idempotent pairs are a natural semigroup invariant. Coxeter-group order and braid-edge labels vary dramatically across types; equality of their zero-Hecke idempotent-pair counts and the structural identity of every branching degree-three Coxeter diagram have a motivated classification consequence. The five-vertex degree-four star is a sharp structural boundary, not an arbitrary numerical extension.
